tool: art-department/tools/clean-ai-sheet.py --out-frame 176 (Pillow + numpy cleanup, lossless) then art-department/tools/split-spritesheet.py (Pillow, lossless cells) then scripts/ingest-art.mjs (sharp) --no-grade
model: T's built-in image generator drew the sheet (2026-10-30) from the shipped stand-in portrait; nothing in this run called a model or spent anything
graded_note: A4 / A6b, grade once - here, zero times. The stand-in portrait toll-keeper.webp was ingested in colour, and the sheet drawn from it carries the portrait's own saturation, so these cells ingested --no-grade and graded: false on the frame manifest says so.
license_note: Derived from T's image-model sheet, itself drawn from the stand-in portrait toll-keeper.webp. T, 2026-10-29, D115: "The images we use for everything are open source."
source: art-department/masters/enemies/toll-keeper.sheet.webp (2048x768 WebP q95 master, 8 columns x 3 rows, rows idle / struck / attacking; prompt in toll-keeper.prompt.txt), drawn from the shipped stand-in portrait toll-keeper.webp
portrait_note: A7: the SHA-256 of the static portrait this set was drawn from. scripts/frame-set-portraits.test.mjs (root npm test) fails when the portrait's bytes no longer match: a swapped portrait retires this set (remove it or regenerate it from the new portrait).
cleanup_report: art-department/masters/enemies/toll-keeper.cleanup-report.json - 44 alpha >= 160 cores; 1 welded core(s) separated at the neck and 1 cut at the gridlines; slivers removed and limbs reassembled as the report lists; anchor measured foot-line (stands: the idle foot line moves 1px (0.4% of the 256px cell, within 6%)); every idle cell translated onto it, each reaction row moved as a whole by its first cell; sheet-wide scale 0.648; A9 idle drift 0.38px (max 3)
method: The image-model master was cleaned by the tool, deterministically and reported, with no hand edits (AN5 Decisions): neighbour slivers dropped by the area centroid of each alpha component, limbs that crossed a gridline reassembled into their own cell, every cell registered by integer translation, then one sheet-wide scale. Cut at 176px (A6) so every cell is under the 12000 B ceiling. The cleaned 1408x528 sheet was split into 24 lossless PNG cells, row-major, and each encoded to WebP q44 by the shared ingest recipe with the grade skipped. The cleaned sheet itself is not committed: the sidecar toll-keeper.sheet.json and the report (which pins its pixels' SHA-256) are.
measured: A6, measured on these exact files: 24 cells at 176px, 135592 B (132.4 KB) in total, mean 5650 B, max 7826 B (toll-keeper-18.webp), min 4784 B (toll-keeper-07.webp) - against 47592 B for the static toll-keeper.webp. 2.8x, +85.9 KB for one enemy.
